snippet.title: Die Severed Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Die Severed is a horror roguelike gambling game where you put your body on the line. Beat the odds with unique dice and abilities to pay off your debts, or die trying.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4269720/Die_Severed/

#roguelike #indiedev #indiegame #horrorgaming
